error.ssh_pending: Connecting through the SSH host {host} comes with the SSH lane; clear the tunnel to connect directly

edit.no_key: Read-only: the table has no primary key
edit.read_only: Read-only: the connection is set to read-only
edit.open_transaction: The SQL tab left a transaction open on this connection: COMMIT or ROLLBACK it there, then write back
edit.no_info: Read-only: could not read the table's key ({error})
edit.null_key: A row's primary key is NULL; it can't be found to update

grid.not_inline: Line breaks and binary values can't be edited in the grid; use an UPDATE in the SQL tab
grid.generated: The database computes this column (generated, computed or identity); it can't be edited

engine.ca_as_server: The server's certificate is marked as a CA, which rustls does not accept as a server certificate. Give the server a certificate that is not a CA (signed by your CA), or use the require mode.
engine.lost: The connection to the server was lost: {error}
engine.sqlite_missing: The SQLite file {path} does not exist
engine.no_object: There is no table or view named {name}
engine.ca_not_pem: {path} is not a PEM certificate file: {error}
engine.key_mismatch: The row with {key} matched {count} rows instead of exactly one; nothing was written
engine.instance_port: The instance {instance} needs its port: looking it up through SQL Browser isn't supported. Enter the instance's TCP port.
engine.ca_required: verify-ca checks the certificate against your CA only: choose its CA file, or use verify-full
